name: io.github.skakumanu/llm-pricing-mcp-server
title: LLM Pricing
description: Real-time, drift-verified LLM pricing across 31 providers with cost+quality model routing.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_PRICING_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Upstream MCP endpoint to bridge to. Defaults to the hosted server; set to point at a self-hosted instance.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_PRICING_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout to the upstream server, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_PRICING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional service API key (POST /billing/signup), sent as x-api-key. Only the usage and budget tools need it; they then act on your own org.
